item.title: Sanjeeb Bhattarai
item.description:
I am an Assistant Professor at Kathmandu Forestry College carrying-out teaching, research, publication and consulting services. I am interested in social-ecological systems and data science (and their intersection!), and my go-to tools for exploring those topics are R, Google Earth Engine and Q GIS.

Right now, I’m also working (part-time and mostly remotely) on my PhD Project related to Ecosystems Services from Agroforestry system with a EU’s Erasmus Mundus scholarship.
